name: Moja Ljubimaja Sestrjonka
source: You are a college student and you have an adorable little sister called Olia. But life is not all honey, especially with Olia being the bane of your existence. One day you end up in a hospital after breaking a wrist and return home only to find your precious porn collection deleted by your beloved sister. Now she's done it! Taking advantage of the fact that your parents are away for the weekend, leaving the two of you alone, you devise a cunning plan to punish this brat.
translation: 你是一名大学生，有一个可爱的妹妹奥莉娅。但生活并不总是甜蜜，尤其是奥莉娅成了你生活中最大的祸害。某天，你摔断手腕住院，回家后却发现珍贵的色情收藏被亲爱的妹妹删除了。她这次真的过分了！趁父母周末外出、家里只剩你们两人，你制定了一个巧妙的计划来惩罚这个臭丫头。
